name: Selective reception of counsel
description: Desired outcomes shape which counsel is welcomed, resisted, or discounted.
boundaryConditions: does not by itself establish spiritual mediation or divine judgment

name: Royal court consultation
description: Royal decision-making is mediated through counsel, prophetic performance, office, and court procedure.
observableIndicators: prophets speak within a royal audience
boundaryConditions: institutional analysis must remain distinct from spiritual attribution

name: Prophetic speech mediation
description: Speech presented as prophecy mediates interpretation, warning, authorization, or deception.
observableIndicators: prophetic message frames the proposed action
competing prophetic voices interpret the same decision
boundaryConditions: prophetic medium does not settle the source or truthfulness of the message without further argument

name: Narrated spiritual deception
description: The text reports a spirit proposing deception through the speech of prophets.
observableIndicators: deception is described as mediated through mouths of prophets
boundaryConditions: requires textual and theological interpretation and does not license automatic transfer to other cases

name: Divine judicial permission
description: The narrative presents YHWH's judgment as permitting the spirit's proposed mediation.
observableIndicators: council scene frames the event in relation to YHWH
permission language follows the spirit's proposal
boundaryConditions: theological interpretation must distinguish divine sovereignty, creaturely agency, and human responsibility
